name: SMART workflow runner
description: Run one deployed SMART workflow, review each task, and track execution metrics.
instructions: For the SMART workflow runner, keep SMART_ENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_HASH_ID and SMART_ENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_KEY backend-only environment secrets. Never put either in frontend code, Content, data records, API responses, or logs. Keep frontend/src/App.svelte as a route shell and use pages/TasksPage.svelte, CreateTaskPage.svelte, TaskDetailPage.svelte, MetricsPage.svelte, and ConfigurationPage.svelte. Keep backend/main.py as a router composition entrypoint; use routers/ for HTTP routes, services/smart_client.py for the SMART API, services/task_store.py for app-scoped tables, services/task_poller.py for debug-tree refreshes, and services/metrics_service.py for aggregates. Invoke SMART in async mode, persist its returned thread ID, and poll get_debug_tree with bounded backoff. Browser uploads must first be persisted in smart_workflow_task_files using a file field so Hangar stores them as assets; send a base64 data URL to SMART, but never store raw file content in a task record. Show cost only when SMART reports model usage; never estimate it. Persist parsed node metadata, human-readable errors, workflow variables, and raw debug data so task detail can provide both a clear view and an inspectable raw JSON view.
